Power Keepers

Released February 2, 2007 · 108 cards

Power Keepers is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the EX series, released in English on February 2, 2007. It has 108 cards. It includes 81 Pokémon, 16 Trainer and 11 Energy cards, and is not legal in Standard or Expanded.

Illustrators

18 illustrators worked on Power Keepers. Most cards: Ken Sugimori (32), Midori Harada (16), Ryo Ueda (13), Masakazu Fukuda (7), Hajime Kusajima (6), Mitsuhiro Arita (6), Sachiko Adachi (4), Tomokazu Komiya (4).
